Name: Auto-Eat
Author: Permamiss
Description:
This is just a mod I made for myself for quality of life, but I thought I would share it with anyone who may be interested.


What it does:
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Waits for you to completely run out of Stamina[/size]
[*][size=2]Checks your inventory for anything that gives Energy[/size]
[*][size=2]Picks the one that would give the least profit, were you to sell it[/size]
[*][size=2]Makes your character automatically consume it[/size]
[/list]
[size=2]Voila, you are not overexerted! [/size][i][size=1]Unless you didn't have any food, in which case, you are.[/size][/i]


Let me know of any bugs you may find while using the mod. Thanks, and enjoy!

[size=2]This mod is open-sourced. Feel free to look at it and modify it to your liking, and even use pieces toward your own projects. I only request credit for what you use!


[center][url=https://github.com/Permamiss/Auto-Eat]Open-Sourced Code[/url]﻿[/center][/size][size=2]
[/size]
